verdict.rationale: Sierra documents first-party control over tone and style through Ghostwriter prompts, and Voice Personas for designing how the agent sounds across 59 languages and 60+ locales. That covers the control half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows that brand voice actually stays consistent across topics and languages, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: evidence of brand-voice consistency across topics and languages, a dedicated brand-voice/style-guide configuration beyond prompt edits, hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a support leader, I control the agent's tone and brand voice, and it stays consistent across topics and languages

citations.quote: Update workflows, systems integrations, guardrails, tone, and style with simple prompts.
Use Voice Personas to design how your agent sounds, speaks, and connects, powered by a constellation of models tuned across 59 languages.
